general_information.name: SORRY, LEGAL NAME… YOU MEAN THE ONE ON PAPERWORK? I’M GETTING A BIT MIXED UP HERE. IT’S ROBERT — AND THEN… UM, I THINK ANSELL, BUT I’M NOT SURE IF THAT’S EXACTLY WHAT YOU MEANT. COULD YOU SAY IT ANOTHER WAY?
general_information.address: Oh—home address. I’m not great with the whole thing in one go, sorry. I can give part of it, but I’m getting myself muddled with the rest… could you split it up for me?

current_concerns.primary_problems: It’s mostly been since the cancer diagnosis, four months ago. I’ve been low, not much appetite, keeping to myself more… and I’m in between chemo cycles right now, which probably doesn’t help. I keep thinking, I’d rather it took me quickly.
current_concerns.goals: Just to get through the treatment, really. And… to be some use to my wife, if I can.

past_psychiatric_history.previous_therapies: Yes — oncology counselling. It was in 2026, about three sessions, at the cancer centre.; In 2026.; About 3 sessions.

Medication 2: Name Or Description: Yes — ramipril.; Dose: 10 mg each morning.; Start Or Duration: 2014.; Side Effects: No known side effects.

medical_history.medical_conditions: Colorectal cancer. And… I suppose the blood pressure thing too, hypertension.

personal_history.early_childhood: Born and raised in Toronto… from a practical working family, that’s how I’d put it.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: I left school when I was 18 to start a plumbing apprenticeship.
personal_history.significant_relationships: My marriage — 36 years, and it’s current. We’re close. I’ve got three adult children too.
personal_history.future_goals: I want to see my treatment through and get back to the workshop.
